entries.text: clanking over to the fuel depot for a warm cup of heavy oil
entries.why: My joints are dry as a sandstorm and squeaking at every turn.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Little Dart Mk 11 passed 50%!"
His obsession with oil has faded.
He's become a bit obsessed with oil.
Woke up fully charged in the middle of the night. Not sleepy at all.
